Scope: ui/packages/core/src/actions/index.ts, ui/packages/react/src/index.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/types/src/index.ts, ui/packages/types/src/views.ts, ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-visible-when-fault-warning.test.tsx, .changeset/25921-core-reset-action-key-warnings-off-barrel.md, .changeset/25921-react-reset-visibility-warnings-off-barrel.md, .changeset/25921-plugin-detail-reset-activity-warnings-off-barrel.md, .changeset/25921-types-comment-search-result.md, .changeset/25921-i18n-dead-public-form-keys.md + ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts, ui/packages/react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic.ts, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/EmbeddableForm.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/formChrome.ts, ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts, ui/vitest.config.mts, ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, .changeset/25921-collaboration-zero-consumer-exports.md (on `main`)

### ① Derived judgments

Public-surface changes the diff implies, each read against the cited code on `main` and on the head:

- `@object-ui/core` entry loses `resetActionKeyWarnings` — **right**. `actions/index.ts` turns `export * from './actionKeys.js'` into a named list; `actionKeys.ts` declares exactly eleven exports (ten values plus the reset, no type exports), so the ten names re-exported are the complete remainder and nothing else leaves silently. Core's three tests already import the reset from `../actionKeys`.
- `@object-ui/react` entry loses `__resetVisibilityPredicateWarnings` — **right**. The emit, the dedupe `Set` and the reporters stay on the entry; the cross-package tests now import the reset from `react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic`, the same file the vitest alias resolves `@object-ui/react` to (`ui/vitest.config.mts` maps the specifier to `packages/react/src`), so the reset clears the one `Set` the code under test writes. Four app-shell tests already used that path on `main`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` entry loses `resetUnknownActivityTypeWarnings` — **right**. The entry's docblock sentence that justified the export goes with it; `ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE`, `UNMAPPED_ACTIVITY_FEED_TYPE`, `activityRowToFeedItem`, `isRefusedFeedRead` and `SysActivityRow` stay. The one cross-package test imports the declaring module; `RecordDetailView` reaches the same module instance through the mocked-with-importOriginal entry.
- `@object-ui/types` loses `CommentSearchResult` (interface deleted from `views.ts`, row dropped from the entry) — **right as a surface change**: the only producer `useCommentSearch` left in #28385, and no code reader remains anywhere in the tree, in hotcrm or in objectui outside CHANGELOG history. The objectui#10078 pin keeps its two surviving rows, both type and census halves; its controls are untouched. The surface is right; the migration text around it is not (see ④).
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `publicForm.consentRequired`, `rateLimited`, `redirectBlocked`, `requiredHint` leave all ten packs — **right as measured**: no `t()` call site, no dynamic `publicForm.` head covering them (the live heads are the nine siblings), none of the four in `formChrome.ts`'s fallback table that `check:i18n-keys` compares against the pack, and `TranslationKeys` (derived from `en`) narrows by four members. All ten packs edited, so the key-parity test holds. The reading of what these keys were *for* is incomplete (see ④).
- Zero-consumer claim re-read: the four retired names have no non-test reader on `main` outside their packages; the nine `__resetVisibilityPredicateWarnings` cross-package tests the dev found (one console, five app-shell, three components) match the import statements on `main` — the claim's "five" was the under-count, not the dev's nine.
- Accept-set: none. No `packages/spec` schema, node type or stored shape names any of these; `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct on all five.

### ② Semver level

Five changesets, one per package whose entry narrows, each `patch` with a `BREAKING` banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` and exactly one ADR-0087 marker — this is the level the rule assigns a non-protocol breaking change (`patch`, banner and disposition kept). The i18n package getting its own `!` changeset is right: the pack-derived key type is a published surface. The four `runtime-export-retired` operands name a real export that leaves the entry; `no-migration-prescription` on the i18n keys is the category the gate admits for strings no stored shape names, and the PR-body `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` line matches every changeset. Each of the four export changesets carries a FROM/TO line. Clause-②: `no (narrowing)` — correct for a diff that publishes a narrower entry and no spec change.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag "B3 repointed nine cross-package tests, not the five the claim names" — **answered**: nine is the count on `main` (verified file by file); same item, same file class, no surface breach.
- Dev flag "`@object-ui/i18n` gets its own `!` changeset" — **answered**: right, the key type narrows.
- Dev flag "dogfood battery n/a — NOT MEASURED, for the seat to rule" — **answered, no escalation**: no rule in AGENTS.md or `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md` owes a dogfood run for a `ui/`-only narrowing; the diff touches no `packages/**` source the battery builds, and the head's `Dogfood Regression Gate` aggregate concluded success (shards path-skipped). Nothing to measure.
- Dev flag "PR body carries harness attribution lines" — cosmetic, no action.
- `open_questions`: none declared.
- Check-runs on the head, read at 05:40 UTC: every completed run is `success` or `skipped` (Check Changeset ×2, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, Type Check · workspace/source/consumer/debt, TypeScript Type Check, Build UI Deps, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter). Still in progress at that time: `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` 1/16 through 16/16. Those three families are the ones that compile and run the repointed cross-package test imports, so the seat reads their conclusions before any landing step.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing, read against the published entries on `main`:

- The three reset helpers are warn-once memo clearers whose only readers are tests; removing them from the entries takes no capability from a consumer that the packages ever delivered to one — the diagnostic, its prefixes and its dedupe stay public. Design holds.
- `CommentSearchResult` is a type for a search the packages no longer ship. Removing it is the right end state — but the tree it lands in contradicts it. **Must-fix:** `.changeset/25921-collaboration-zero-consumer-exports.md` (pending on `main`, still pending on this head, line 18) tells a host migrating off `CommentSearchReturn` that "the result rows can keep using `CommentSearchResult` from `@object-ui/types`". Both changesets ship in the same release, so the collaboration CHANGELOG would prescribe a TO target the types CHANGELOG deletes in the same version. A migration prescription that names a retired symbol is exactly what ADR-0087 exists to refuse; the gate does not read TO operands, so it did not catch it. Fix: in this PR, reword that line to the local shape the types changeset already gives (`{ comment: CommentEntry; objectName: string; recordId: string; highlight?: string }`). `.changeset/**` is not a governed path; the claim's named surface did not list this file, so the seat widens it by one line.
- The four `publicForm` keys: the PR and changeset say "no screen in the Console or in any `@object-ui/*` package showed them". The key names, yes. The strings, no: `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/EmbeddableForm.tsx` renders byte-identical English hard-coded — `'Please accept the privacy policy to continue.'` (consent gate, ~L361), `'Please take a moment to review your answers before submitting.'` (min-fill-time refusal, ~L374), `'* Required field'` (~L546) — and reads author `texts.redirectBlocked`, while the same package localises its other chrome through `formChrome.ts` and `t('publicForm.*')`. The four keys were the pack half of a localisation that was declared and never wired; `check-i18n-dead-keys` is key-based, so CONFIRMED stands and deleting them is within the card's ruling. Retiring an undelivered capability is a permitted resolution, so this is not a FAIL, but the record of the decision is wrong. **Should-fix:** state in the i18n changeset body that these three strings stay as un-localised English defaults in `EmbeddableForm` (so a later "localise the embeddable form" card knows it re-adds keys rather than discovers a dead end), or the seat puts implement-vs-retire to the card before landing.
- **Should-fix (minor):** `ui/packages/react/src/index.ts` keeps the comment "the emit, the dedupe `Set` and the reset above are still the only ones" beside a list that no longer carries the reset; reword so the next reader is not sent looking for an export that is not there.
- Attempted breaks that did not land: a type export hidden behind the old `export *` (none — `actionKeys.ts` has no type exports); a second module instance behind the relative imports (none — alias and relative path resolve to one file); a README or docs page teaching any of the four names (none; only CHANGELOG history); a hotcrm or objectui consumer (none at hotcrm `a598256`, objectui `b2c0ade`); a dynamic `publicForm.${…}` head reaching the deleted keys (none).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `90c5e25156cdf07707e851432eeaceb93d3261b4`
Local-runs: none
Prior-record: PR comment 6554050725 (head `fef5795d`, FAIL) — this record is the delta on the one commit since, read against the whole PR tree
Scope: .changeset/25921-collaboration-zero-consumer-exports.md, .changeset/25921-i18n-dead-public-form-keys.md, ui/packages/react/src/index.ts + ui/packages/types/src/views.ts (on `main`), ui/packages/plugin-form/src/EmbeddableForm.tsx, ui/packages/react/src/utils/visibilityDiagnostic.ts, scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs; every other path of the PR is unchanged since `fef5795d` and stands as judged in 6554050725

### ① Derived judgments

The delta commit changes no code surface: three files, +5/−5, all comment or changeset prose. Every entry, type and key judgment in 6554050725 holds unchanged on this head.

- `.changeset/25921-collaboration-zero-consumer-exports.md` line 18 — **right**. The `CommentSearchReturn` TO side now prescribes a local interface `{ comment: CommentEntry; objectName: string; recordId: string; highlight?: string }` and says `CommentSearchResult` leaves `@object-ui/types` in the same release. The four members match the interface deleted from `views.ts` on `main` (member for member, `highlight` optional), and the sentence agrees with the types changeset's own FROM/TO line. The prior must-fix is resolved.
- `.changeset/25921-i18n-dead-public-form-keys.md` — **right**. The body now says no translation call read the four keys, that `EmbeddableForm` in `@object-ui/plugin-form` draws the same wording as hard-coded English defaults for `consentRequired`, `rateLimited` and `requiredHint`, shows `redirectBlocked` only when the author supplies `texts.redirectBlocked`, that those defaults were never localised through these keys and stay un-localised English, and that an author localises per form through `config.texts`. Each claim is true of `EmbeddableForm.tsx` on `main`: the `texts` interface carries all four fields, the three defaults are the `??` literals at the consent gate, the min-fill-time refusal and the required-hint line, and the redirect-blocked line renders only under `redirectRefused && texts.redirectBlocked`. The disposition marker's added clause reads the same way. The first should-fix is resolved.
- `ui/packages/react/src/index.ts` — **right**. The comment now says the emit and the dedupe `Set` in `visibilityDiagnostic` are the only ones; one `_warnedVisibilityPredicates` Set exists there and the reset is no longer named as a listed export. The second should-fix is resolved.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: five `patch` changesets with a BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` and one ADR-0087 marker each; the delta edits prose only and moves no frontmatter. The edit to the pending collaboration changeset alters its TO text, not its level, arm or marker. Clause-②: `no (narrowing)` — correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `Check Changeset` is `failure` on this head: `check-empty-changeset` refuses a PR that modifies a changeset it did not add — the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, whose remedy in the gate's own text is "do NOT restore it — say so on the PR and get it confirmed". The correction itself is right (judged above) and was the prior record's must-fix, so restoring the base line would put the false sentence back. **Escalated to the maintainer, not a must-fix of the diff**: the red stays until a maintainer confirms on the PR. At the time of reading, neither the PR body nor any PR comment says the correction was made on purpose; the seat posts that note with the confirmation request so the gate's first step is met.
- All previously in-progress families concluded on this head, read at 06:09 UTC: `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` 1/16 through 16/16 and the `Test UI` aggregate all `success`; every other run is `success` or `skipped`. The three families that compile and run the repointed cross-package tests are green.
- Dev flags from 6553963516 (nine-not-five importers, i18n `!` changeset, dogfood NOT-MEASURED, attribution lines) stand answered as in 6554050725; no new dev flag and no `open_questions` on this head. No new card comment since the dev report.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing is unchanged from 6554050725 and holds: the three reset helpers leave entries that keep every diagnostic, prefix and dedupe public; `CommentSearchResult` goes with its retired producer, and the one same-release prescription that still named it now names the local shape instead; the four `publicForm` keys are retired as the pack half of a localisation that was declared and never wired, and the record of that decision now says so where a future "localise the embeddable form" card will read it. No must-fix remains; no should-fix remains. Attempted breaks on the delta: a member mismatch between the prescribed local interface and the deleted one (none); a claim about `EmbeddableForm` the code does not bear out (none); a second dedupe Set the new comment would mislabel (none).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-ula03v`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw2uhdSeHYfnZdAf4V`

**VERDICT: PASS**

domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw2uhdSeHYfnZdAf4V

**Deliberate correction of a pending release note: needs the maintainer's confirmation.** `Check Changeset` is red on `90c5e251` because `check-empty-changeset` refuses this PR's edit to `.changeset/25921-collaboration-zero-consumer-exports.md`, a changeset this PR did not add.

- **The note:** line 18 told hosts migrating off `CommentSearchReturn` that "the result rows can keep using `CommentSearchResult` from `@object-ui/types`".
- **What changed under it:** this PR retires `CommentSearchResult` from `@object-ui/types` (B6). Both notes ship in the same release, so the old sentence would point hosts at a symbol that is gone.
- **The correction:** the TO side now gives the local shape `{ comment: CommentEntry; objectName: string; recordId: string; highlight?: string }` and says the type leaves `@object-ui/types` in the same release. Restoring the base text would republish the false sentence.

This was the contract record's must-fix, 6554050725. The delta record, 6554291417, is a PASS on `90c5e251`. Every required context is green, and `Check Changeset` is not a required context. The seat will not land this PR until a maintainer confirms the correction here.

席位意见:同意。五个 ui 包的公共入口拿掉零消费者面(三个测试用 reset 助手、`CommentSearchResult`、四个未被读取的 `publicForm.*` 文案);同时更正待发布的 collaboration 变更说明,不再让宿主继续用已退役的类型。维护者已从 `os-zhuang` 标为就绪并入队,即对该更正的确认。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `90c5e25156cdf07707e851432eeaceb93d3261b4` · 2026-11-01T06:14Z

1. **形态:** 31 files; `Part of #25921` (B1, B3, B4, B6, B10); 0 governed paths, under 3000 lines. Base `main`.
2. **前提实测:** claim 6553495326, ledger `out/25921-ledger.md`. Zero non-test readers of the four names were confirmed in this repo and in hotcrm. The nine B3 importers are repointed to the declaring module, which the seat accepted.
3. **门禁 check-runs:** every required context is green on the head. The only red run is `Check Changeset` (not required): `check-empty-changeset` refuses the deliberate correction of `.changeset/25921-collaboration-zero-consumer-exports.md`, as stated in 6554297324.
4. **契约复审:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. FAIL 6554050725 at `fef5795d` (must-fix: the pending note named the retired type). Delta PASS 6554291417 at `90c5e251`. Five `patch` changesets, each with a BREAKING banner and an ADR-0087 disposition, match `Metadata-protocol: none`.
5. **范围外去向:** B2, B5, B7, B8, B9, B11, B12 and B13 stay on #25921, which returns to `pm:queue` after this lands.
6. **落地条款:** the maintainer readied and queued this PR from `os-zhuang` at 2026-11-01T06:13:37Z, after the correction request 6554297324. The seat takes that as the required confirmation.
